name: Cilli Hütte
beschreibung:
Perched high above the valley, Cilli Huette delights mountaineers and hikers with rustic atmosphere and wholesome Tyrolean fare. Its sunny outdoor terrace offers breathtaking views of the Zugspitze massif and surrounding ranges.

The hut serves as a favourite stop and staging point for alpine hikes, via ferratas, and winter ski days directly on the mountain slope.
kurzbeschreibung: Cilli Huette on the Hornberg provides authentic alpine hut charm and majestic panoramas in the Tyrolean Zugspitz Arena.
